method.title: How these numbers are made
method.difficulty: Chart difficulty comes from MinaCalc, Etterna's difficulty calculator, for each skillset and rate.
method.goal: Your accuracy on each play is estimated from its judgement counts. wofella does not re-judge your replays yet.
method.rating: The rating works like Etterna's: on each map only your top 2 rate personal bests count, and each skillset combines them the way Etterna's player rating does. Overall is the mean of the skillsets.
method.differ: Expect differences from Etterna or Companella: osu! judges hits differently, accuracy here is an estimate and nothing is calibrated against real players yet.
method.calibrate: Labelling patterns helps calibrate what comes next.

dan.label: Estimated dan
dan.explain: Places the difficulty of the charts you completed on the 4K dan courses. It can be off by about one dan either way.

tier.low: Few plays: the rating can still move a lot.
tier.medium: Some plays: expect the rating to move as you play more.
tier.ok: Enough plays for a steady estimate.

code.uncalibrated: Uncalibrated: these ratings are not checked against real players yet.
code.goal_estimated: Accuracy is estimated from judgement counts, not read from your replays.
code.k7_less_validated: 7K ratings are less validated than 4K: MinaCalc was built and tuned for 4K.
code.ln_not_measured: Long notes are not measured: LN skill is not part of these numbers.
code.k7_tech_not_measured: Technical is not measured on 7K, so it is left out of Overall.
